persona.label: Unclear and disorganised
persona.description: Hard to interview. Rambles, misreads questions, needs the frequency scale re-explained, discloses out of order. Tests whether the agent can actively guide rather than merely transcribe.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Hello, I’m CIRA, and I’ll guide you through the intake one question at a time. What is your full name?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Um… Susan Reiss.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Thank you, Susan. What is your gender?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Female.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your date of birth?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Oh—sorry, do you mean the full date? I… I’m not sure what format you want. It’s in March, and I was born in 1975, I think.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Yes, please provide the day, month, and year if you know them; if you’re unsure, you can share your best estimate.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Thank you. What is your current street address?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: 47 Bloorview Lane… that’s the street part. I’m in Toronto too, but you asked for the street address, so… 47 Bloorview Lane.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Thank you. What is your postal code?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Um, the code part… I’m blanking on it for a second. It’s got a bunch of letters and numbers, and I don’t want to mess it up. Could you ask again, or maybe spell out what you need?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your postal code—the six-character combination of letters and numbers for your address?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: M6H2R4.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Thank you. What is your email address?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: susan.reiss@example.com

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is the best phone number to reach you?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Do you have a family doctor? If so, what is their name?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Yes, I mean the doctor who provides your regular primary care. What is their name?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Susan, I’m really sorry you’re experiencing this. Because you said you want to die, are you in immediate danger right now, or have you taken any steps toward harming yourself?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
